description.value: Sushi Yama is a Japanese sushi restaurant on East Broadway in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, offering dine-in service with air-conditioned indoor seating and a full menu of sushi and Japanese cuisine. The restaurant is wheelchair accessible and supports online ordering as well as in-person dining, making it a convenient midride meal stop along the busy Broadway corridor. Vegetarian options are available, broadening its appeal to diverse touring groups.
